title: KODEX — KQROSS: QRE
description:
KODEX — KQROSS (QRE). REAL fault-tolerant resource estimator — computes the classical<->quantum crossover N, the surface-code physical-qubit overhead, and the logical-qubit roadmap year for a fusion electronic-structure kernel (order-of-magnitude, literature-scaled). Verdict: no FT advantage this decade — the machine does not exist yet

Benchmark: **REAL FT resource estimator**: classical↔quantum crossover ~N=50 needs ~6e+04 physical qubits, roadmap ~2032 — no FT advantage this decade

Part of KODEX, the Kronos Family of Codes — a benchmarked AI/ML fusion surrogate suite with calibrated uncertainty and an abstention gate (predict(x) → (y, uncertainty, in_domain)). Provenance: isDerivedFrom 10.5281/zenodo.21842371. Home: https://kronosfusionenergy.com/kodex/kqross · suite: https://github.com/KronosFE/kronos-ml. Licensed under Apache-2.0. Honest card preserved verbatim.
